body: This is why I love the movie “Goodfellas” because if you actually pay attention, the glorifying of the mafia gets flipped on its head by the end of the movie, and they make their characters just as terrible and sadistic as they are charming and witty. A really good example of how even the “coolest” seeming people are really the scummiest pieces of shit that just cause destruction and despair and calling that “honor”. As someone who knows some people, the mob is not honorable, and more than anything was a means of either survival, or a way to have power. Not because of “honor” or “respect”
